Автоматика остановила насос, потому что давление упало. Виктор перекрыл клапан.
PREDICATE:
перекрыл
TARGET:
клапан
CANDIDATE RELATIONS:
AFFECTED_OR_CONTENT: TARGET is the direct semantic target: an entity/content affected, perceived, possessed, selected, summoned, or referred to by PREDICATE; a person can be OBJECT when the action directly targets that person (for example, someone is summoned/selected/seen), not when the person is merely the addressee contacted by speech, telephone, or messaging
RECEIVER_OR_ADDRESSEE: TARGET is the receiver/addressee/beneficiary/destination that receives an object, information, communication, or benefit; this includes the person being addressed or contacted by speech, telephone, or messaging even when no separate message OBJECT is stated; mere personhood does not make TARGET a RECIPIENT, and a person directly seen/met/summoned/selected is normally the direct semantic target instead
ORIGIN: TARGET is the origin from which another participant, object, or information comes, moves, is removed, or is obtained; TARGET does not become a constituent of the result
ABSENT_ENTITY: TARGET itself is explicitly represented as absent from, excluded from, or not participating in the event (for example, the event happens without TARGET); ordinary negation of the predicate/event or contrastive negation of another filler does NOT make TARGET an absentee
SECONDARY_PARTICIPANT: TARGET is a secondary co-participant that is not the actor, direct object, receiver, source, or absent entity
PLACE: TARGET specifies where or to what place the event/participant is located or moves; it is not the origin it comes from
PREDICATED_STATE: TARGET is a property, condition, class, status, or value predicated of a participant
TIME_POINT: TARGET locates the event on a timeline and answers when it happens; it does not describe how the event is performed
ELAPSED_DURATION: TARGET specifies the elapsed temporal length of the event/state and answers how long it lasts
CAUSE: TARGET is the reason or prior circumstance that causes/explains why the event happens
INTENDED_GOAL: TARGET is the intended goal or result for which the event is performed
INSTRUMENT: TARGET is an instrument or tool used as a separate implement/device/object to perform the event; it remains an instrument rather than becoming material of the result
CONSTITUENT_MATERIAL: TARGET is a substance or material constituent/component from which an affected or resulting entity is made, formed, or composed; it is not a separate implement and not an origin of motion
QUANTITY_OR_MEASURE: TARGET specifies quantity, count, size, degree, or non-temporal measure; it is not elapsed duration
MANNER_OR_PROCEDURE: TARGET describes the manner, procedure, or method by which the event is carried out, rather than naming a separate tool or constituent material; a concrete implement such as a hammer/pencil/key is TOOL
QUESTION:
Which single relation does TARGET have in this event? Use the whole sentence. Grammatical negation (НЕ) negates the proposition or contrasts a filler; by itself it never changes that filler's semantic role and never means ABSENT_ENTITY. Choose ABSENT_ENTITY only when TARGET itself is explicitly represented as absent/excluded/non-participating. Distinguish AFFECTED_OR_CONTENT from CONSTITUENT_MATERIAL strictly: MATERIAL means TARGET is a substance/component incorporated into a different affected or resulting entity; if TARGET is itself the affected/content/result entity, it is not MATERIAL. Choose only among the listed candidate relations.
CHOICES:
AFFECTED_OR_CONTENT
RECEIVER_OR_ADDRESSEE
ORIGIN
ABSENT_ENTITY
SECONDARY_PARTICIPANT
PLACE
PREDICATED_STATE
TIME_POINT
ELAPSED_DURATION
CAUSE
INTENDED_GOAL
INSTRUMENT
CONSTITUENT_MATERIAL
QUANTITY_OR_MEASURE
MANNER_OR_PROCEDURE

TASK:
Choose one label from CHOICES for TARGET's semantic relation to PREDICATE. Use the whole sentence. Negation of an event or contrastive filler does not change TARGET's role and does not imply ABSENT_ENTITY. Use ABSENT_ENTITY only when TARGET itself is absent, excluded, or non-participating. Return only the label.
